pages.text: Surround a Limestone Furnace with Crystal Glass.

A Glassblower Furnace has a regular input, fuel, and output. It processes ordinary smelting recipes and is faster for results recognized as glass. Use input from above, fuel from the side, and a hopper or chest-and-hopper below.
Smelt Strange Sand into Crystal Glass. Use panes and frames for construction, or take glass to a $(l:atum:people/villagers)Glassblower$(/l) and check their offers.
Smelt Strange Sand into Crystal Glass.
